content.text: Night wakings at 8 are common during stress, growth spurts, or a shift in the school-year rhythm - try a short, boring check-in with her (no screens, low light, same few words each time) to help her body learn it's safe to resettle alone. If it's been more than a couple of weeks or she seems anxious during the day too, worth mentioning to her doctor.
